The e-paper init sequences and waveform LUT bytes in
src/sideload_pi/display/luts.py and src/sideload_pi/display/epd.py are adapted
from the Waveshare e-Paper Python demos:

  https://github.com/waveshareteam/e-Paper
  RaspberryPi_JetsonNano/python/lib/waveshare_epd/epd2in13.py
  RaspberryPi_JetsonNano/python/lib/waveshare_epd/epd2in13_V2.py
  RaspberryPi_JetsonNano/python/lib/waveshare_epd/epd2in13_V3.py
  RaspberryPi_JetsonNano/python/lib/waveshare_epd/epd2in13_V4.py
